channel.title: ClearGlass Insights — Governed AI, Cybersecurity & Autonomy
channel.description: A founder-led field journal for governed AI, autonomous agents, cybersecurity architecture, OSINT workflows, and high-trust software systems.

item.title: The Secure Deployment Agent: Governed Authorization for Every Production Change
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: A deploy button is a loaded verb. The ClearGlass Secure Deployment Agent turns shipping software into a governed, authorization-bound process: five operating states, a scope contract, a permission matrix, least-privilege secrets, pinned supply chain, and a rollback plan for every change.

item.title: ClearGlassInc: The $0-to-$1,000,000 Corporate Execution Plan
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: An 18-month operating plan to reach $1,000,000 CAD in collected corporate revenue by selling governance, cybersecurity, procurement-intelligence, compliance and AI-oversight services, then converting recurring work into managed services and licensed technology.

item.title: Frontier Intelligence Briefing: Quantum Gravity, ASI Timelines, Biosecurity & the Economic Singularity
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: An EYES-ONLY styled field briefing on five frontier vectors: quantum gravity progress, near-term ASI timelines and risks, the biosecurity landscape, economic-singularity scenarios, and the truth about time-travel and future-prediction claims — with a sober assessment on each.

item.title: Ethical Sales Psychology: A 100K Revenue System Prompt for ClearGlassInc Artemis
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: A ClearGlassInc Artemis-ready prompt and operating system for building persuasive, ethical sales funnels using reciprocity, proof, authority, urgency, risk reversal, follow-up, KPIs, and human-trust guardrails.

item.title: Inside the ClearGlass Command Center: Designing a Cyber Defense Console That Earns Trust
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: The design and engineering decisions behind the ClearGlass Command Center — a cinematic cyber defense console where every animation supports evidence: live telemetry, risk gauges, governed pipelines, and human-in-the-loop approval gates.

item.title: ClearGlass AgentOps: Microsoft Foundry Future Stack
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: Twelve enterprise-grade briefs for secure agent deployment with Microsoft Foundry Agent Service, Microsoft Agent Framework, Copilot Studio, Entra identity, tracing, governance, and ClearGlass AgentOps.

item.title: ClearGlassInc Artemis Resume Builder: Self-Evolving AI Intelligence Platform Blueprint
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: A production full-stack design document for ClearGlassInc Artemis with ontology-driven agents, policy-as-code, evals, safe self-improvement, and Apollo-controlled deployment.

item.title: Governed AI Threat Modeling: The ClearGlassInc Artemis GTM Visual Growth Engine
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: A conversion-first blog, visual spec, email drip, KPI model, and JSON prompt pack for governed AI threat modeling campaigns.

item.title: Cybersecurity Architecture for Agentic Software
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: The command-control patterns, agent identity, permission scoping, append-only audit, egress boundaries, and kill switches required before AI agents touch real infrastructure.

item.title: AI Agents Are the New Insider Threat
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: Agents hold credentials, access, and goals — the textbook insider profile — and behavioral tooling can't see them. The AIRF framework: Identity, Intent, Blast Radius, Ledger.

item.title: Zero Trust Is Outdated
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: Zero trust answered "who are you?" The agentic era asks "should this action happen, and at what cost?" The Adaptive Trust Systems Model: action trust, intent verification, learning policy, trust economics.

item.title: The OSINT Workflow That Survives Contact With Reality
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: Collection planning, machine-enforceable source grading, entity resolution without hallucinated merges, claim lineage, and analyst review loops that don't drown in noise.

item.title: ClearGlassInc Artemis: The Self-Evolving AI Intelligence Platform
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: A full-stack blueprint for mission-speed intelligence with ontology-driven agents, continuous evals, policy-as-code enforcement, safe self-improvement loops, copyable code, and a power-user prompt system.

item.title: AI Agent Governance: The Governed Autonomy Playbook
item.dc:creator: Desmond Otieno Odhiambo
item.description: The bottleneck to deploying AI agents isn't intelligence — it's accountability. Inside the Governed Autonomy model: the Four Gates and the Risk Router that let enterprises deploy autonomous AI without getting burned.
